title: Swapping dehydrator reservations
titleZh: 交換食物乾燥機的預約時段

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I booked the dehydrator for Saturday morning, but my pears aren’t ripe. Still using it Sunday afternoon?
turns.zh: 我訂了星期六早上的乾燥機，但梨子還沒熟。你星期日下午還要用嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. My apple slices are ready. I could take Saturday if you take Sunday.
turns.zh: 要。我的蘋果片已經可以處理了。你用星期日，我可以用星期六。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Deal. Bring your thin trays. My thick ones would keep the lid from closing.
turns.zh: 好。帶你自己的薄托盤。我那些厚托盤會讓蓋子關不上。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will. Let’s tell the kitchen desk today so they update the bookings before the weekend.
turns.zh: 我會帶。今天就告知廚房服務台，讓他們在週末前更新預約。
